assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production pixel-art overworld sprite sheet for Clément in a classic handheld monster-catching RPG. Image 1 (6931.png) is STRICT pixel style reference: huge head about half total height, simple dark one-pixel outline, tiny white eye glints, limited palette, no excessive detail. Image 2 clement-v2.png is CHARACTER IDENTITY: young man light brown mixed skin, short tight black curls, thin dark glasses, white open collar rolled sleeve shirt, black trousers, white sneakers. True transparent background. Exactly a regular grid THREE columns and FOUR rows, all cells equal, no labels. Row1 facing down/front, row2 left, row3 right, row4 up/back. Each row: left step, standing, right step, same identity/proportions/alignment in every cell. Entire silhouette including feet inside its cell with wide transparent gutters. Aim for native logical 32x32 pixels per cell, whole sheet96x128 upscale in perfectly square pixels; character occupies 20px wide by28px tall, baseline same in all cells. No shadows, no text, no ground, no props. Must look like reference player, not illustration.
assets.processing: Transparent generated 3×4 sheet normalized to twelve 32×32 cells using nearest-neighbor; alpha threshold150; each silhouette19×28.
